briefdescription.para: This function sends an IPI request to get the XilPuf library version and capability bits running on the PLM.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to Xil_LibInfo. LibVersion and Capability are filled on success. The Version and NistStatus fields are reserved for XilPuf and must be ignored.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if the library information is read successfully
XST_INVALID_PARAM if any input parameter is invalid
XST_FAILURE if there is a failure
Perform input parameter validation. Return XST_INVALID_PARAM if input parameters are invalid.
Query library info via the Features command using a valid PUF api-id as the selector, so the command succeeds and the server returns the library version/capability at fixed indices.
Send request to server via SMC for EL1 non-secure AArch64 applications or via IPI mailbox for other environments.
